name: Derelict
source:
Lex has been here for too long. The days blend into weeks... into months... into years. An eternity of boredom. 

She's worried that she might be stuck here forever - until one day she gets an alert that someone is hailing the station. Maybe her luck is finally about to change...

[From [url=https://fisheranimal.itch.io/derelict]Itch.io[/url]]
